description:
A checkout link for an account product. 'pro' (HeritageDeed Pro, $39 a month): every county's full surplus
        funds and tax sale lists with history and CSV, daily new-listing alerts, full lookup results. 'pro_reports'
        ($199 a month): Pro plus 10 title reports a month. 'api_credits' ($250 per pack of 10 title
        reports, `packs` 1-20): prepaid reports that do not expire. Monthly plans renew until cancelled on /account.
        Give the user `checkout_url`. Without an API key on the connection, Creem asks for their email and the plan
        or credits land on that email's account (they sign in at /account with a code). With an API key on the
        connection, they land on the key's account.
name: buy_plan
